mapper.sql: select tallot.id, tallot.code, tallot.material_id, tallot.batch_code, tallot.allot_num, tallot.out_warehouse_id, tallot.out_warehouse_name, tallot.in_warehouse_id, tallot.in_warehouse_name, tallot.allot_status, tallot.auditor, tallot.create_by, tallot.create_time, tallot.update_by, tallot.update_time, tallot.dept_id, tallot.dept_name, tallot.del_flag from t_allot tallot
mapper.delete: update t_allot set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_allot set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.update: update t_allot set allot_status = #{allotStatus} where code = #{code}
mapper.select: select a.code, m.code materialCode, m.name materialName, a.batch_code batchCode, a.allot_num allotNum, a.out_warehouse_name outWarehouseName, a.in_warehouse_name inWarehouseName, a.allot_status allotStatus, a.create_time createTime from t_allot a left join t_material m on m.id=a.material_id where 1=1 and a.code like concat('%',#{code},'%') and m.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%') and a.allot_status=#{allotStatus} order by a.id desc
